wifi_ssid.description: The SSID of the Wi-Fi network to connect to.

wifi_pass.description: The password for the Wi-Fi network.

wifi_hidden.description: Whether the Wi-Fi network is hidden.

wifi_retry_interval_s.description: The interval in seconds to wait before retrying Wi-Fi connection.

protocol.description: The protocol to use for communication.

http_poll_interval_ms.description: The interval in milliseconds for polling the server.

http_authorization_token.description: The authorization token for the server.

mqtt_broker.description: The address of the MQTT broker. Use 'mqtts://' for making use of TLS connections.

mqtt_port.description: The port of the MQTT broker.

mqtt_username.description: The username for the MQTT broker.

mqtt_password.description: The password for the MQTT broker.

mqtt_topic_prefix.description: The prefix for the MQTT topics.
